constraints.text: Preserve all existing DC-MP-IMG2 exit requirements and hard DAG. No Runtime, GPU/upload, new dependency, unsafe/FFI, security setting, main/release or fabricated capability. Record design choices in owning canon before source edits, update derived plan in same change.

Existing non-instrumented WIC stdout/argv/exit behavior remains unchanged. Optional sidecar has finite byte/row caps, exclusive owned fresh root, monotonic clock domains with units, actual stage timestamps, no metadata-derived paths and explicit incomplete traces.

Separate encoded bytes, admitted decoded bytes, BGRA conversion, declared scratch/known reservations from process working set/private bytes and sampled concurrent cohorts. Never call sampled maxima a true peak or sum asynchronous per-process maxima. Validate PID/start lifetime/executable identity. Internal scratch/true allocation peak and unavailable probes stay null NOT_MEASURED with reasons.

Exercise pre-admission, pre-OnLoad, requested-during-OnLoad when actually reachable, post-OnLoad, timeout and pre-publication cases. Distinguish process termination/reap from cooperative in-decoder cancellation. Never publish success/partial output after refusal/cancel. Record unreached boundary NOT_MEASURED; repeat cancellation and confirm no residual direct child.

Manifest carries single/global deadlines, maximum cases/concurrency/output/work-root/trace/sampling/report limits. Fail closed for budget or lifecycle mismatch; never reuse/delete pre-existing work roots. No unbounded wait or process creation.

Actual decode_compare consumer smoke with real WIC PNG/BMP independent known RGBA oracle, JPEG structure only, oversize/unsupported refusals. Independent validation and all sixteen specified negative classes; structural arithmetic reproducible and OS/time nondeterminism explicitly separated.

W2 focused/negative tests, W1 selftest+real matrix, harness/media regressions, unchanged full quality script plus feature quality and Python R0. Pin complete source+Native evidence commit, independent Refine Quality/Build within600sGate300scheck16MiB bounds, status/inspect/verify/candidate+artifact correlation. Finite exact successful workspace/target disposal only after tracked evidence and unchanged before/after integrity. New repaired source needs new commit/Gate; docs-only repair no duplicate succeeded Gate. Tern complete fresh fixed-SHA review to0/0/0 then limited acceptance under ADR9, safe dev integration, next directive.

outputs.description: Opt-in probe instrumentation, bounded Windows matrix CLI, strict independent verifier/negative regressions, latest tracked sanitized fixture/identity/manifest/stage/resource/cancel/oracle/quality/Gate/storage/Tern evidence and honest remaining capabilities.

acceptance.statement: Real WIC PNG/BMP decode via existing consumer and independent RGBA oracle; JPEG structure only; refusals/cancel publish no successful output and W1 legacy regression remains intact.

Actual bounded single and three-child lifecycles produce identity-bound stage/memory observations with units, observer, clock, completeness and sampling limitations; unavailable internal scratch/true peak/cooperative cancellation remain unmeasured.

Reject missing/empty/duplicate cases, source/PID/lifetime mismatch, wrong clock comparison, reversed stages, materialization after refusal, decoded without output, success after cancellation, invented peaks, asynchronous maxima sums, sampler failure, report/work caps, partial records/output and cleanup mismatches.

Required quality plus new fixed-source independent Quality/Build integrity and complete-read Tern PASS0/0/0 justify only W2 limited technical closure, never full MP-IMG2/Upload/Runtime/Native GUI or performance attainment.

evaluation.requirement: Run real Windows WIC matrix and consumer twice, independent inventory/pixel/stage/accounting/lifecycle oracle, meaningful fail-closed negatives and actual cancel/refusal cases.
Full default/feature Rust and R0 Python quality with actual skips, W1 regression, pinned independent Refine Gates/cleanup/integrity/disposal and linked complete Tern0/0/0 review.
